decisions.reason: The cleaning soap was launched as part of a visible wood-floor care range that matches the firm's core parquet business, and with only one year of results any weak sales can still be put down to the start-up phase.
Maintenance oil is central to the firm's announced oiled-floor care offering and builds on its expertise in wood, so management stays committed to it.
The care product completes the publicly presented care system for oiled floors, and dropping it after one year would undercut the earlier decision to launch the range.
The moisture-protection underlay is an accessory sold together with parquet installations, needs little further investment and supports the firm's flooring direction, so it is kept.
The high-density foam underlay is somewhat less central and overlaps with Product D, but its low cost and the firm's public commitment to a complete flooring system favor keeping it.
The oak parquet floor is the core product, with high sunk investment and the strongest commitment, so the firm persists with it.
